name: ReelWage
tagline: Payroll built for the people who actually make the movie.
positioning: ReelWage handles crew timecards, union fringes, and W-2 filings for independent producers running lean shoots—so payday never holds up the schedule.

hero.h1: Wrap the day. Pay the crew. Move on.
hero.sub: ReelWage turns paper timecards, deal memos, and union rate tables into clean payroll runs—so your gaffer gets paid right the first time and your accountant sleeps.

features.title: Union fringes, calculated
features.description: IATSE, Teamsters, and SAG-AFTRA rate tables baked in. Overtime, meal penalties, and pension & health fringes tally themselves on every timecard.

features.title: Timecards from set
features.description: Your 2nd AD approves digital timecards from their phone at wrap. No more chasing crumpled paper in a Manila envelope on Monday.

features.title: W-2s and 1099s handled
features.description: We file federal and multi-state withholdings, cut year-end forms, and keep your loan-out paperwork audit-ready for every crew member.

features.title: Cost reports that match the budget
features.description: Export payroll straight into your line-item budget so your UPM sees actuals against Movie Magic without re-keying a single number.

features.title: Multi-state, multi-shoot
features.description: Location days in three states this month? ReelWage tracks jurisdiction, incentives, and residency so nothing gets flagged later.

features.title: Built for small crews
features.description: Whether it's a six-person commercial unit or a 40-person indie feature, you only pay for the seats you actually staff.

testimonials.quote: We ran a 22-day feature across two states and closed payroll in an afternoon. Before ReelWage that was a week of my life every single time.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitfield

testimonials.quote: My crew stopped emailing me about paycheck errors. The fringe math is just right now, and that trust is worth more than the subscription.
testimonials.name: Marcus Ferreira

testimonials.quote: As a one-woman production company, I needed payroll that didn't require a payroll department. This is the first tool that actually fit my shop.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

pricing.blurb: For commercial and short-form units staffing a handful of crew at a time.

For production companies running several shoots at once.

homepage.footerBlurb: ReelWage is payroll software for independent film and video producers. Pay your crew accurately, file on time, and keep the production moving.
